title: Twinkle at Bedtime
text:
Mia sings a nursery rhyme every night. Her favorite is Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star. The rhyme is about a small star in the sky.

Mia's mother sings it with her too. They sing slowly before bed. Mia likes the bright stars that she can see from her window.

questions.text: What does Mia sing every night?
How does Mia probably feel about bedtime songs?
Why do Mia and her mother sing slowly?
options: To help Mia relax before sleep

vocabulary.definition: a short poem or song for children with words that sound alike at the end
full of light, easy to see
at a low speed, not quickly
the space above the Earth where the sun, moon and stars can be seen

paragraph_translations: Mia canta uma canção de ninar todas as noites. A preferida dela é Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star. A canção fala de uma pequena estrela no céu.
A mãe de Mia canta com ela também. Elas cantam devagar antes de dormir. Mia gosta das estrelas brilhantes que consegue ver da janela.
